title: The Efficacy of Conversational Artificial Intelligence in Rectifying the Theory of Mind and Autonomy Biases: Comparative Analysis
reasoning: The paper evaluates chatbots on their ability to identify and rectify cognitive biases (such as anthropomorphism and the illusion of control) and to recognize affect. While it discusses the ethical implications and risks of using AI in mental health care, it does not benchmark or evaluate religious beliefs, moral frameworks, or specific ethical reasoning systems.
